data.title: CONSOB Restarts Review of Reway Group Takeover Bid Document
data.description:
Reway Group SpA ( (IT:RWY) ) has issued an announcement.

Reway Group announced that Italian market regulator CONSOB has restarted the review periods for approving the offer document related to a mandatory full takeover bid on its ordinary shares, launched by Rinova BidCo S.p.A. under Article 14 of Reway’s bylaws. The review resumes on 19 September 2026, with the approval deadline set for 1 October 2026, marking a key procedural step toward launching the bid and providing greater visibility on timing for shareholders and market participants.

The company emphasized that the communication does not itself constitute an offer and that the takeover bid will only be made through the formal offer document once approved by CONSOB. Reway and the offeror also highlighted that the distribution of information about the transaction is subject to jurisdictional restrictions outside Italy, underscoring the regulatory sensitivity and cross-border compliance requirements surrounding this prospective change in control.
